name: Star Arthur Densetsu I - Wakusei Mephius
original_name: スターアーサー伝説I 惑星メフィウス
source:
In 3826 Jamil leads an invasion against Galactic Federation and destroys one planet after another. The main character Star Arthur is searching for the legendary sword to crush Jamil's ambitions.

[derived from [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
3826年，贾米尔向银河联邦发动入侵，一颗又一颗行星惨遭摧毁。主人公“星之亚瑟”开始寻找传说之剑，试图粉碎贾米尔的野心。

[整理自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
